name: Messages Shortcut Actions
description: Use shortcuts to archive, trash, or mark Google Messages conversations read or unread, with optional shortcuts for navigation.

archive-conversation.description: Archive the selected or hovered Google Messages conversation

trash-conversation.description: Move the selected or hovered Google Messages conversation to trash

mark-unread-conversation.description: Mark the selected or hovered Google Messages conversation as unread

mark-read-conversation.description: Mark the selected or hovered Google Messages conversation as read

open-archived.description: Open Archived conversations in Google Messages

start-chat.description: Start a new Google Messages chat

open-spam-blocked.description: Open Spam and blocked in Google Messages
